Prayer : Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of Cons India, to issue Writ of Mandamus directing the respondents 1 and 2 to fr Rules by providing promotional avenues for the members of the petitioner Association who are working as Food Inspectors by providing first prefer to them who are qualified and eligible for promotion as per 2.1.2:1 (iii the Fssa Rules as Designated Officers in the Department of Food, Safety Drug Administration, Government of Tamil Nadu by taking into considerati the representation made by the petitioner's Association dated 18.01.2016 For Petitioner : Mr.K.Srinivasamurthy
texts.facts: This writ petition has been filed for issuance of a Writ of Mandamus directing the respondents 1 and 2 to frame rules by providing promotional avenues for the members of the petitioner Association who are working as Food Inspectors by providing first preference to them who are qualified and eligible https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis for promotion as per 2.1.2:1 (iii) (a) of the FSSA Rules as Designated Officers in the Department of Food, Safety and Drug Administration, Government of Tamil Nadu by taking into consideration the representation made by the petitioner's Association dated 18.01.2016. 2. The members of the petitioner Association are all B.Sc., Chemistry graduates and joined the Municipal Administration Department of the Government of Tamil Nadu as Sanitary Inspectors/ Sanitary Officers in the local bodies viz., the Corporations and Municipalities. The petitioners were sent for training in terms of Section 9 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 r/w Rule 8 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1955 and on completion of training posted as Food Inspectors. After the Food, Safety and Standards Act, 2008 came into force on 05.08.2011, the petitioners were appointed as Food Safety Officers in the 2nd respondent Department and are continuing as such. The petitioners claim promotion to the post of designated officers but the respondents have not framed any rules for promotion of the Inspectors to the post of designated officers. The petitioners therefore filed the writ petition.
